title: Timed Writing Practice: Opinion Essay on Assessment and Feedback
prompt: Some people believe that the most effective way to improve student learning is through regular, small-scale assessments, while others argue that fewer, larger assessments allow students to develop deeper understanding. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, explain which approach you consider more beneficial for learners and why. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出双方观点及自己的立场，再用约30分钟完成至少250词的完整议论文，最后留约5分钟检查任务回应、段落衔接与语法。注意：题目中的所有情境与数据均为模拟练习材料，并非官方雅思试卷；请勿背诵模板，务必明确讨论两种观点并给出自己的立场。
